items.name: toaster
items.title: Cloudlet Toaster
items.description: Client Provider/Toaster adapter with shadcn theme tokens. The application explicitly owns its @cloudlet/toast controller.
items.docs: Import Toaster into a client owner and pass its controller. Import @cloudlet/toast/styles.css once before the local toaster.css (the wrapper already imports both). The owner creates/disposes its controller; do not share one across requests. See https://cloudlet.dev/docs/components/toaster for lifecycle, theme and SSR.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Cloudlet Color Picker
items.description: A round swatch that morphs into a color picker on interruptible springs: a saturation × brightness area, hue and optional opacity sliders, an editable value in hex, rgb, hsl or oklch, an eyedropper where the browser has one, and copy. ColorPickerPanel renders the same panel inline. No dependencies.
items.docs: Import ColorPicker (or ColorPickerPanel) from components/ui/color-picker/color-picker; it imports its own color-picker.css. color/onChange take any hex, rgb(), hsl() or oklch() string and return one in `format` (hex by default); `formats` limits the switch, `alpha` adds opacity, `name` adds a hidden input. Styles read the shadcn tokens --background, --foreground, --border, --ring and --muted. The panel is not portalled: give an `overflow: hidden` ancestor `overflow: visible`.

items.name: color-palette
items.title: Cloudlet Color Palette
items.description: One to four colors in a row, each a Cloudlet color picker: an add button that opens the new color's picker at once, removal with Delete or the pointer's ×, one Tab stop with arrow keys, springs that grow and fold the swatches. Installs the color picker with it.
items.docs: Import ColorPalette from components/ui/color-palette/color-palette; it imports its own color-palette.css and the color picker it is built on. colors/onChange take and return an array of hex, rgb(), hsl() or oklch() strings in `format`; `max` caps the count (4 by default), `name` adds one hidden input per color, `labels.picker` translates the pickers. Styles read the shadcn tokens --background, --foreground, --border and --ring.
